hero.title: About WangHai
hero.subtitle: WangHai Server (WHS) — a free and open Minecraft community centered on players, integrating redstone engineering, rail transit, and architecture.

vision.title: Who We Are
vision.text: WangHai is a community-driven, non-profit Java Edition Minecraft server, now in its second world. We are built around vanilla survival, and the means of production belong to all players — every farm, every rail line, and every public storage hall here is built and maintained by the community, together.

items.title: Redstone Engineering
items.desc: Survival redstone at the core — a full range of mob and resource farms, managed and maintained by the community.

items.title: Rail Transit
items.desc: A unified, centrally planned rail network with dedicated lines connecting every corner of the community.

items.title: Architecture
items.desc: Survival and creative servers run in parallel — large builds are planned in creative first, then realized in survival.

items.title: Community Governance
items.desc: The server belongs to all players. Admins are elected by players, and the rules are upheld by the community.

members.title: Members
members.text: All whitelisted members of WangHai Server (avatars provided by mc-heads.net)

items.title: WangHai Sets Sail
items.desc: The server was founded by stevendjr, establishing an open, free, player-centered community vision.

items.title: Passing the Torch
items.desc: The server entered its second world (Java 1.21.10). 1410happy_ took over as owner, providing machines and technical support, while founder stevendjr serves as co-owner.

items.title: Built and Governed Together
items.desc: The admin team is elected by players; an entrance questionnaire and review group were introduced; rail projects are centrally planned, and the full-item storage hall and farm system keep growing.

items.title: Forever Building
items.desc: New members keep joining and infrastructure keeps expanding — every block of WangHai is laid by players' own hands.

items.title: Owned by Players
items.desc: The server explicitly states that all players are the owners. The means of production are communal — no private ownership or monopolies.

items.title: Democratic Election
items.desc: The admin team is elected by players, with dedicated roles such as the rail transit project lead.

items.title: Entrance Review
items.desc: New players must pass an entrance questionnaire to join, ensuring every member understands and agrees with the community rules.

items.title: Quasi-Communal Economy
items.desc: Most production resources are shared publicly; private holdings of valuables like netherite and diamonds are strictly limited.

features.title: Highlights

items.title: Full-Item Storage Hall
items.desc: A public, categorized storage hall covering every item — take what you need, maintained by everyone.

items.title: Rail Transit Network
items.desc: Centrally planned and led by a dedicated lead, the rail network connects settlements and facilities with ease.

items.title: Mob & Resource Farms
items.desc: Zombified-piglin towers, mob farms and more provide a stable supply for the community.

items.title: MCDR Utilities
items.desc: Convenient features powered by MCDR: daily check-in, coordinate lookup, and spectator teleport.

items.title: Mod Policy
items.desc: Client-side assistive mods like minimaps are allowed; tools such as schematic printers are restricted to strictly defined scenarios.

items.title: Creative Planning
items.desc: Large builds are tested and planned on the creative server before being realized in survival.

features.aiText: WangHai has integrated the GamesAI plugin: type !!ask in-game to chat with the AI, ask questions, or even delegate tasks to it. The AI bot (Mineflayer) can autonomously pathfind, mine, build and craft; the !!data public database lets all players share a growing community memory.

rules.title: Code of Conduct

items.title: No Cheating or Malice
items.desc: Cheating, griefing, harassment and inappropriate content are prohibited and punished accordingly.

items.title: Shared Resources
items.desc: Natural resources must not be privately claimed or monopolized — the means of production belong to all players.

items.title: Protect Server Performance
items.desc: When TPS drops too low, players must proactively stop large machines to prevent the server from crashing.

rules.fullRulesHint: The complete rules are provided in the entrance questionnaire

about.title: About This Website
about.text: This website is the official portal of Wanghai Server, owned and operated by the server team. We aim to offer players a secure and efficient interface for account management and server services, as well as to serve as the official community and data asset management platform. The built-in wiki is maintained by the server team — guides, rules and knowledge all in one place.

items.title: Accounts & Security
items.desc: Register, log in, and manage avatars and profiles in one place. Passwords are salted and hashed, and sessions use signed tokens to keep accounts safe.

items.title: Entry Exam
items.desc: Take the whitelist questionnaire online with automatic grading. Passing automatically whitelists you on the game server, while admins can review and re-score answers.

items.title: Live Server Status
items.desc: Real-time player count, TPS and player cap, reported automatically by the game server through the MCDR plugin.

items.title: Message Center
items.desc: System announcements and direct messages in one place, so exam results and review notifications are never missed.

items.title: Member Wall
items.desc: Browse whitelisted members and click any avatar to view player info and their profile page.

items.title: Bilingual & Dark Mode
items.desc: Switch between Chinese and English, choose light, dark or system themes, with responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.

items.title: Server Wiki
items.desc: The official wiki covers guides, rules and knowledge. Every page is written in Markdown with the outline parsed automatically from headings, with real-time Chinese/English switching and per-page edit permissions.

about.wikiText: The wiki collects the server's guides, rules and knowledge. All content is written in Markdown and stored in the database, with outlines parsed automatically from headings; it supports real-time Chinese/English switching, revision history with one-click rollback, and per-page edit permissions, maintained together by the community.
about.techText: The frontend is built with Vue 3 + Vite, the backend runs on FastAPI + SQLite, and real-time communication with the game server is handled by an MCDReforged plugin; wiki pages are stored as Markdown in SQLite, with outlines parsed from headings at render time. The project is open source under the MIT license.
